topic: Impacts of Climate Change and Renewable Solutions
key_concepts: Greenhouse gases trap heat and strengthen the greenhouse effect.
Burning fossil fuels has increased atmospheric carbon dioxide since the Industrial Revolut
Current global warming is mainly caused by human activities.
Global temperature, ocean heat, and ocean acidity are increasing.
Ice sheets and glaciers are shrinking while snow cover decreases.
Sea level is rising and Arctic sea ice is declining.
Extreme weather events are becoming more frequent.
Typhoon Haiyan/Yolanda caused severe storm surge and damage in Tacloban.
Climate change impacts vary by region and include biodiversity loss and longer fire season
Renewable energy and individual actions can help mitigate climate change.
SDG 13, 14, and 15 address climate action, life below water, and life on land.
